## REQ-RES-PROFILE-001

**Fields of the Profile DataSet**

The Payload of a Profile DataSetMessage contains the mandatory field Resources, an array of distinct strings, each the name of a resource of MG 7.5.1 or of a common service of MG 7.5.2, each listed only once; no other field.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The entity supports the resource Profile (REQ-CMP-018).
- Scope: MG 7.5.1, MG 7.5.2
- Refs: MG 8.3.7, SF-066
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.7-cf84476b, MG-8.3.7-f5251ea7

> Each name must be listed only once.
> — MG 8.3.7

Notes: MG 8.3.7 gives Type String with Value Range "&lt;array of resources>"; B2.5 describes an array of String (V-PAY-014). The closed set of names is REQ-TOP-012.

## REQ-RES-PROFILE-002

**Profile lists exactly the supported resources**

The Profile of an asset lists every resource the entity serves for that asset – the mandatory resources of its compliance level, the optional ones and the common services it supports – and no resource or common service it does not support.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The entity supports the resource Profile (REQ-CMP-018).
- Scope: MG 1.3
- Refs: MG 8.3.7, MG 9.1.7, SF-066
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.7-516da9f2, MG-8.3.7-954d25a2, MG-9.1.7-1694ed5f, MG-9.1.7-71073f4c

> It contains an array of all mandatory and optional resources (7.5.1 Resources) and common services (7.5.2 Common Services) which are supported, so that a consumer can discover e.g. the service NewDataSetWriterId.
> — MG 8.3.7

> Which resources are mandatory depends on the compliance level of the application or device (1.3 Compliance Domains and Levels).
> — MG 9.1.7

Notes: Same rule as REQ-CMP-021 from the view of the DataSet; the Profile of a subordinate asset lists what the representing application serves for it (SF-066 (c), GL-ADR-019).

## REQ-RES-PROFILE-003

**Get Profile carries no Profile object**

A Get Profile NetworkMessage contains no Profile DataSetMessage; its Messages are empty or contain only the helper DataSets PaginationRequest and Locale.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Scope: MG 8.3.11, MG 8.3.12
- Refs: MG 9.1.7, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.7-8f595df4

> In combination with the method Get, the payload requires an empty NetworkMessage.
> — MG 9.1.7

> A Profile object is not included.
> — MG 9.1.7

## REQ-RES-PROFILE-004

**Get Profile is answered with all addressed Profile objects**

A Get Profile without Source is answered with all available Profile information of the application (itself and all subordinate assets), each in its own DataSetMessage of a single NetworkMessage published to Pub/Profile; a Get Profile with Source is answered with the Profile of that asset on Pub/Profile/&lt;Source>.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The entity supports the resource Profile (REQ-CMP-018).
- Refs: MG 9.1.7, SF-062
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.7-1883d668, MG-9.1.7-96f1ecd8

> Via the &lt;Method>/&lt;Resource>[/&lt;Source>] combination Get/Profile[/&lt;Source>], the publication of this information to the Pub/Profile[/&lt;Source>] topic can be triggered.
> — MG 9.1.7

> A topic, such as Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Get/Profile, must trigger a publication of all available Profile information, each in its own DataSetMessage added to a single NetworkMessage and published to the topic Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Pub/Profile.
> — MG 9.1.7

Notes: Pagination of large answers is REQ-PAG-005, ReplyTo is REQ-MSG-015.

## REQ-RES-PROFILE-005

**Pub Profile carries Profile objects and optionally Pagination**

A Pub Profile NetworkMessage contains Profile DataSetMessages and optionally the helper DataSet Pagination; it contains no PaginationRequest and no DataSetMessage of another resource.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: publisher
- Refs: MG 9.1.7, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.7-09291906

> In combination with the method Pub, the payload contains DataSetMessages of type Profile and optional Pagination (8.3.11.2 Pagination).
> — MG 9.1.7

Notes: A Locale is only meaningful in a Get and ignored in other methods (REQ-LOC-002).
